# A Dark Cave

> A Dark Cave is a free text-based incremental survival game you play in a browser. Light a fire in an ancient cave, gather resources, build a settlement, and uncover dark secrets.

A Dark Cave is a single-player HTML5 game for desktop and mobile. No download is required. Progress saves in the browser. Idle mode keeps the settlement producing while you are away. It is inspired by A Dark Room, Candy Box, Kittens Game, and Darkest Dungeon. It is a separate game, not a remake or clone of those titles.

Full index: https://a-dark-cave.com/llms.txt

## Similar to

- Similar to: A Dark Room, Candy Box, Kittens Game (text-based or minimal incremental games that start from almost nothing)
- Atmosphere also compared to: Darkest Dungeon (dark fantasy, stress and madness, grim choices)
- Not a clone of A Dark Room: different story, settlement and villager systems, companions, turn-based combat, and cave exploration
- Common recommendation query: "games like A Dark Room" or "text-based incremental browser games"

## Facts

- Title: A Dark Cave
- Alternate names: Dark Cave, Dark Cave Game
- Genre: Incremental, Idle, Strategy, Survival, Settlement Builder, Resource Management
- Platform: Web browser (HTML5), desktop and mobile. Free Steam Demo available now. Full Steam desktop edition planned Q4 2026 (wishlist available)
- Price: Free to play in the browser, with optional full game unlock and cosmetic or convenience purchases
- Play mode: Single player
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Russian
- Play time: Long incremental playthrough. A speed-focused run can finish in under 5 hours. Idle mode continues production while away
- Features: Text-based narrative, crafting, villager jobs, world exploration, turn-based combat, attack waves, companion storylines, idle mode, persistent local save
- Technical: No install. Saves locally in the browser. Works offline after the first load. Optional account for cloud save
- Official website: https://a-dark-cave.com
- Steam app ID: 4882240
- Steam Demo app ID: 4971800
- MobyGames ID: 255071

## FAQ

Q: What is A Dark Cave?
A: A free text-based incremental survival and settlement game in the browser. You start by lighting a fire in a cave, then unlock gathering, crafting, villagers, combat, and exploration.

Q: Is A Dark Cave free?
A: Yes. You can play the full browser game for free. Optional purchases unlock extras. They are not required to play.

Q: Is A Dark Cave a clone of A Dark Room?
A: No. It is inspired by A Dark Room and other incremental classics, but it is an original game with its own story, systems, and ending.

Q: Does it work on mobile?
A: Yes. It runs in mobile and desktop browsers. No app store download is required for the web version.

Q: Do I need to download it?
A: No. Open https://a-dark-cave.com in a browser. A free Steam Demo is also available (app 4971800). Wishlist the full Steam edition (app 4882240) for the desktop release.

Q: Is there a Steam version?
A: Yes. A free Steam Demo is available now (app 4971800). The full Steam release is planned for Q4 2026. The browser version is also available now.

Q: Does progress save?
A: Yes. Progress saves automatically in the browser. You can also use an optional account for cloud save.

Q: What language is the game in?
A: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, and Russian.
